name: Followthrough

decision.source: User selected: Build connected v0; I will configure credentials in app/.env. Guided-mode mechanics resolved by S2 initializer under this instruction.
decision.scope: All ten Core features FT-01 through FT-10 remain required; this is a connected application, initially run locally.
decision.credential_checkpoint: Independent source implementation and local isolated checks proceed while the owner configures app/.env. Missing configuration blocks dependent provider operations and connected checks. No mock, fixture, local test, or queued request constitutes external proof.
decision.external_authority: Building and validation do not authorize external messages or Books writes. Require an explicit owner action in the running UI or unambiguous authenticated reply tied to the exact pending action; synthetic test-recipient and fresh-account boundaries still apply.

runtime_packages.name: ffmpeg-static
runtime_packages.purpose: Local WAV conversion for WhatsApp OGG voice messages; Node core cannot decode OGG. FFMPEG_PATH optionally overrides bundled binary.

runtime.dependency_rule: No added runtime package or remote frontend asset without a justified spec update.
runtime.verified_local: Node v24.22.1 and built-in SQLite 3.53.4 verified by parent during this build

persistence.scope: One persistent store for loops, fixture provenance, network, sourced qualification, pending drafts/actions, exact approvals, provider IDs, sessions, event deduplication and scheduled brief slots.
persistence.transactions: Use atomic state changes and unique idempotency keys. External writes keep intent, response identifiers, and uncertain outcome for reconciliation; never retry an unknown write blindly.

frontend.choice: Vanilla semantic HTML, CSS and browser JavaScript
frontend.surface: One responsive Where I stand page plus shared login
frontend.assets: Local assets only; no CDN fonts or scripts

auth.choice: One shared owner password from OWNER_PASSWORD; scrypt verifier, never plaintext persistence outside app/.env
auth.session: Random opaque session ID; hashed server-side session record, expiry, HttpOnly SameSite cookie; Secure with HTTPS
auth.guards: Authenticate all private UI/API routes, require same-origin and per-session CSRF protection for mutations, rate-limit login, bind approvals to exact immutable action payload/version and reject replay or ambiguity
auth.webhooks: WhatsApp challenge token for GET; raw-body SHA-256 HMAC with WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET for POST before parsing; deduplicate event IDs

jobs.choice: In-process scheduler with persistent unique local-date/slot records
jobs.rules: At most one brief per scheduled slot, within two minutes; no automatic late catch-up or unprompted message between slots. App must remain running; missed slots are visible. Handle London daylight saving via timezone conversion, not fixed UTC offsets.
jobs.outbound_gate: ENABLE_JOBS=false and ENABLE_POLLING=false by default. Viewing UI or starting the process does not enable scheduled sends or background ingestion. Only the owner enables each flag after configuring and approving recipients/provider accounts.

hosting.choice: Railway, one Docker service from app/Dockerfile, one replica, volume mounted at /data with DATA_DIR=/data/run, TRUST_PROXY=true, health check /health (decided 3 Nov, Vince account)
hosting.pending: Public URL into APP_URL and the WhatsApp callback after the first deploy. Local runtime alone cannot receive Cloud API webhooks or prove 24-hour scheduling.

ai.text: Muse Spark Open on Baseten at MODEL_BASE_URL (OpenAI-compatible) with MODEL_NAME and MODEL_API_KEY; optional VISION_MODEL_* for receipt photos if image input fails
ai.constraints: No invented model ID; show missing/unavailable provider state. Provider errors never become fabricated drafts, facts, receipts or account balances. Owner must verify model-host retention and sandbox access.

voice.request: multipart request JSON and audio WAV file; request includes model, audioEncoding WAV, mode PUSH_TO_TALK; response transcript
voice.conversion: Pinned ffmpeg-static 5.3.0 local binary converts WhatsApp OGG to WAV; FFMPEG_PATH is an optional override. Validate media type/size, use argument arrays without shell interpolation, and bound duration/resources. Complete notes are capped at two minutes; conversion uses a one-second sentinel and rejects overlimit audio instead of transcribing a truncated note.

enrichment.web: Fetch only owner-approved public shop URLs; restrict HTTP(S), block credentials, private/reserved/loopback/link-local IPs including IPv6, revalidate DNS and every redirect, bound response type/size/time, never execute remote scripts
enrichment.evidence: Each AI-derived qualification fact requires a URL and exact supporting quotation from retrieved text. Uncertain or missing evidence stays unknown; do not interpret lack of a mention as a false Indian-coffee flag.
enrichment.instagram: Implement an optional official Instagram Business Discovery adapter using INSTAGRAM_USER_ID, INSTAGRAM_ACCESS_TOKEN and GRAPH_API_VERSION; query /{ig-user-id}?fields=business_discovery.username(name){username,biography,website,media.limit(10){caption,permalink}}. Null fixture profile makes no query. A supplied profile without approved professional-account access remains incomplete qualification, never scraped or invented. Owner verifies permissions/account eligibility. Source: https://developers.facebook.com/docs/instagram-platform/instagram-graph-api/reference/ig-user/business_discovery/

providers.zoho: Fresh Mail and Books accounts only; OAuth refresh flow and region-aware endpoints from ZOHO_REGION. No bank/money movement API.
providers.books: Reads contacts/invoices/payments/expenses/cash balance; approved expenses, sales receipts and items only within spec allowance; map expense account, cash account, stall customer and each lot books_item_id. Customer-payment recording is allowed by spec but never moving money.
providers.whatsapp: Cloud API with owner-configured version, strict test recipients and signed webhooks. Outside the 24-hour window, verified APPROVED single-body-variable templates render exact customer content and are signature-checked before send; owner brief template includes all drafts and dashboard URL. Within-window exact action messages support tap or quoted affirmative approval.
providers.cash: Use fresh configured Zoho cash-account balance and invoice reads. On missing/error/stale provider reads display unavailable and timestamp; never substitute fixture totals or zero as connected truth.

design_system.source: frontend-design skill; plan reviewed against coffee-importer owner operations brief before implementation

type.editorial: Georgia, serif only for an optional coffee provenance heading
type.scale: 14px supporting, 16px body, 20px section, 32px page heading; tabular figures for quantities

design_system.layout: Left-aligned quiet navigation and a working ledger: due loops and approval controls are primary; cash/owed/stock in a compact summary band, network as the single distinctive visual, expandable sourced lead background below or alongside it. On mobile use one column and readable overflow for true tables.
wireframe: Desktop: navigation | due loops and approvals | selected lead evidence
Phone: heading, summary, due loops, approvals, network, selected lead evidence
principles: Use amber for provenance or actionable attention with sufficient contrast, never decorative gradients.
Use varied hierarchy and spacing rather than identical cards or KPI hero tiles.
Keyboard focus, labelled forms, status messages, touch targets, reduced motion and 320px layout are baseline.
Show source and freshness near each claim; visibly distinguish illustrative data, pending provider access and verified connected records.
design_system.review: Rejected the generic cream-serif coffee dashboard and decorative cards. The central working ledger and relationship map reflect owner decisions and sourced connections; no external font/CDN assets.

routes.state: GET /api/state (authenticated current state with provenance and provider freshness)
routes.actions: POST /api/actions/:id/approve, /edit, /drop (authenticated, CSRF protected; exact pending action)

action_log.fields: ISO timestamp, event type, relevant loop/action/event IDs, source/provenance and provider receipt where applicable; redact tokens and secrets

synthetic_data.provenance: Owner dataset is not present at initialization. A clearly labelled illustrative synthetic starter is permitted for isolated implementation checks; owner must replace or approve and map it before provider operations. Never label it owner-provided or real data.
synthetic_data.boundary: Every dataset email ends @example.test; WhatsApp numbers are null or configured verified test recipients; validate on startup before any provider operation. Connected operations require SYNTHETIC_DATA_APPROVED=true after owner review and mapping.

conditional: MODEL_API_KEY when model endpoint requires authentication
FFMPEG_PATH optional override for bundled ffmpeg-static binary
WHATSAPP_BRIEF_TEMPLATE and WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE for approved template delivery outside messaging window
VISION_MODEL_BASE_URL, VISION_MODEL_NAME, VISION_MODEL_API_KEY only if Spark Open rejects image input
MAIL_FROM_COFFEE for every email to a coffee counterpart
INSTAGRAM_USER_ID and INSTAGRAM_ACCESS_TOKEN for authorized official Business Discovery enrichment; owner verifies professional-account permissions
SYNTHETIC_DATA_APPROVED=true only after owner review and provider mapping; default false blocks connected operations on illustrative starter
ENRICHMENT_ALLOWED_HOSTS comma-separated owner-approved public shop hosts; empty disables web enrichment

WHATSAPP_WABA_ID and WHATSAPP_FOLLOWUP_TEMPLATE for verified approved customer follow-up templates outside the 24-hour window. Templates have exactly one BODY variable and optional static FOOTER; no other components.

remaining_open.question: Fresh Zoho accounts, region and record mappings; two owner test emails and up to five verified WhatsApp test numbers
Instagram supported official API access/permissions; public shop URL allowlist and owner approval
Railway URL into APP_URL and the WhatsApp callback after first deploy (vendor decided 3 Nov)
Voice Transcribe price (slug, JSON mode and image input confirmed 3 Nov; the Meta Model API key covers Voice Transcribe, confirmed 4 Nov)
Chase parking limit/reopen policy remains unresolved; no invented automatic parking or reopening

verification_boundary: Local checks may prove code and safeguards only. Core completion still requires app/evals.md provider records, actual test-inbox delivery, real model/transcription responses, fresh connected numbers and the 24-hour brief observation. Initializer has performed no external send, Books write, deployment or provisioning.

implementation.local_checks: 33 isolated node:test cases; syntax check; nine isolated Playwright browser cases; high-confidence secret-pattern scan; independent S2 artifact grade 7/7
operational_limitations: Uncertain provider writes require verified operator reconciliation, with no automatic write retry.
Failed inbound processing and missed/failed brief slots remain visible for operator review.
Outside-window owner briefs use a verified template and dashboard approval; multi-action brief replies never authorize a send.
A brief exceeding the supported complete template size is blocked before sending.
